summary: The study demonstrates the use of atomic layer deposition (ALD) to fabricate niobium nitride (NbN) thin films for superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors (SNSPDs). The ALD technique allows for conformal coverage and wafer-scale fabrication, which is beneficial for novel device concepts. The films were characterized for their transport properties and single-photon response, showing promising results for detector applications.
evidence: We demonstrate and characterize superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors (SNSPDs) made from atomic layer-deposited (ALD) NbN layers. ... The ALD technique could open up the possibility to fabricate NbN-based detectors on the wafer scale and to conformally cover also non-planar surfaces for novel device concepts.
